_about: SAMPLE weekly brief drafted with Gemini + Google Search. Every item had a source the search returned; a person reviews before anything is sent. Dates and deadlines go stale: check before use.

items.title: Coffee Cherry Advance Fund
items.sms_en: Need cash before your coffee is sold? The govt's Coffee Cherry Advance Fund gives advance pay. Nyeri is a top recipient. Ask your cooperative to apply.
items.sms_sw: Unahitaji pesa kabla kahawa kuuzwa? Mfuko wa Serikali wa Malipo ya Awali ya Kahawa unatoa malipo ya mapema. Nyeri inaongoza. Uliza chama chako.

items.title: National Coffee Revival Programme
items.sms_en: The govt's Coffee Revival Programme offers certified seedlings & support to increase your income. This is an ongoing program. Contact your cooperative.
items.sms_sw: Mpango wa Serikali wa Ufufuzi wa Kahawa unatoa miche bora na usaidizi kuongeza mapato yako. Huu ni mpango endelevu. Wasiliana na chama chako.

items.title: Commodities Fund Coffee Loans
items.sms_en: Need a loan for your coffee farm, machinery, or development? The Commodities Fund has an office in Nyeri. Applications are ongoing.
items.sms_sw: Unahitaji mkopo kwa shamba la kahawa, mitambo, au maendeleo? Mfuko wa Bidhaa (Commodities Fund) una ofisi Nyeri. Maombi yanaendelea.

items.title: Wambugu Farm Agri Expo
items.sms_en: Farmers! Attend the Wambugu Farm Agricultural Exhibition on July 24-25, 2026 at Wambugu Farm ATC, Nyeri. Learn modern tech & meet experts.
items.sms_sw: Wakulima! Hudhuria Maonyesho ya Kilimo ya Wambugu Farm tarehe 24-25 Julai, 2026 katika Wambugu Farm ATC, Nyeri. Jifunze teknolojia na kukutana na wataalam.
items.publisher: Nyeri County Department of Agriculture, Livestock and Aquaculture Development

items.title: Nyeri National Show
items.sms_en: Visit the Central Kenya National Show in Nyeri, Sep 9-12, 2026 at Kabiruini Showground. See new innovations & get climate-smart agriculture training.
items.sms_sw: Tembelea Maonyesho ya Kitaifa ya Nyeri, Sept 9-12, 2026 uwanja wa Kabiruini. Jifunze ubunifu na kilimo kinachostahimili mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
items.publisher: The Agricultural Society of Kenya (A.S.K) Nyeri Branch

items.title: NCE Auction Prices
items.sms_en: NCE Auction Sep 29: The 2025/26 season ended with an average price of KES 117 per kilo of cherry (USD 294 per bag). Total sales reached KES 839M.
items.sms_sw: Mnada wa NCE Sept 29: Msimu wa 2025/26 umekamilika kwa bei ya wastani ya KSh 117 kwa kilo ya cheri (USD 294 kwa gunia). Mauzo yote yalifikia KSh 839M.

items.title: New Payment Rules
items.sms_en: New Coffee Act 2026 rule: Farmers will now be paid through the Direct Settlement System (DSS) within 5 days of a sale. This starts from Oct 2026.
items.sms_sw: Sheria mpya ya Kahawa 2026: Wakulima sasa watalipwa kupitia Mfumo wa Malipo ya Moja kwa Moja (DSS) ndani ya siku 5 baada ya mauzo. Hii inaanza Okt 2026.

items.title: New Marketing Channels
items.sms_en: The new Coffee Act 2026 gives you more choice. You can now sell your coffee through the NCE, direct sales, an international exchange, or other new ways.
items.sms_sw: Sheria mpya ya Kahawa 2026 inakupa chaguo zaidi. Sasa unaweza kuuza kahawa yako kupitia NCE, mauzo ya moja kwa moja, soko la kimataifa, au njia zingine.
